meta.description: Centralized prompt templates for h3-comic-builder. All prompt generation uses these templates via template_engine.js.
meta.template_syntax: Template uses {{variable}} syntax. Arrays join with ', '. Nested access via {{object.field}}. Conditional via {{#if var}}...{{/if}}.

compositions.right: character on right side of frame
